item.title: 5. Performance Evaluation and Improvement
item.description:
1. Overview

ISO/IEC 42001 §9 and §10 cover the cycle of confirming whether the AI management system is achieving its intended results and improving where it falls short. From an open source perspective, §9.1 (Monitoring and measurement) is linked with open source compliance metrics.

2. §9.1 Monitoring and Measurement: Open Source Compliance Metrics ★

ISO/IEC 42001 requires monitoring and measuring the performance of the AI management system. Integrate existing open source compliance metrics into the performance indicators of the AI management system.

item.title: Management: Continuous Checks and Audit Readiness for Internal Operational Systems
item.description:
Where this page fits

Checking once at adoption and stopping there is not management. Open source risk continues throughout operation, and new vulnerabilities are disclosed after adoption. This is the management (monitoring) step, the last procedure of the FSEC guide, and it corresponds to continuous monitoring in ISO/IEC 18974. It is the step with the greatest weight in the financial sector.

Documents produced here: periodic reassessment records, and audit evidence packages.
